description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyDetailedModel class, which models detailed information about a job vacancy in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits for serialization and defines the schema for API documentation. The class constructs its attributes based on a Vacancy entity, including nested properties like job title and hiring manager details.

classes.name: VacancyDetailedModel
classes.description: A model representing detailed vacancy information, used for API serialization and documentation within the recruitment module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the VacancyDetailedModel with data from a Vacancy entity and sets up serialization filters and attribute mappings.
